_comment: Design Automation Activity TEMPLATE for RevitLinkDetector, shared across all supported Revit years. appbundle-register.js reads this once per year (from scripts/revit-versions.json) and substitutes {{YEAR}}/{{ENGINE}}/{{APPBUNDLE_ID}}/{{APPBUNDLE_ALIAS}} before POSTing it. Kept as its own file (rather than inlined in the script) so the Activity shape can be reviewed/diffed on its own, independent of the per-year loop logic.

hostModel.description: The host .rvt file to read link references from. Downloaded to the working directory as hostModel.rvt — must match LinkDetectionHandler.InputLocalName exactly.

result.description: The JSON result (LinkDetectionResult) this add-in writes. Must match LinkDetectionHandler.OutputLocalName exactly.

description: Reads a Revit {{YEAR}} host file's saved TransmissionData link references and reports them as JSON, without opening the document.
